source_row.rationale: Beyond general read-back verification requirements, some facilities and regulatory frameworks place additional restrictions on telephone orders, such as limiting their use for certain high-risk medication categories or requiring the ordering provider to co-sign the order within a specific timeframe, reflecting the recognition that telephone communication (without visual/nonverbal cues) carries added risk of miscommunication compared to in-person verbal orders.
source_row.source_detail: Additional Considerations for Telephone Order Safety
source_row.source_name: The Joint Commission / Facility Policy — Telephone Order Requirements
source_row.stem: A nurse receives a telephone order from a provider for a new medication, and a colleague assumes telephone orders are handled with exactly the same considerations as any in-person verbal order with nothing extra to think about.
